# Lada walks into a beauty, fashion & cosmetics firm

Somewhere right now, in a beauty, fashion & cosmetics office, someone is doing exactly what the myths describe — and has never heard of **Lada**. This file is the introduction.

## Before the Office, the Story

**Origins.** Lada appears in slavic tradition as love, beauty, spring.  The name's meaning, "Lady, order", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

**Worship and Memory.** Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Lada in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.
